# Hand-added contacts are free

`BT-3` · Owner decision

Hand-added contacts are free on every surface (Contacts create, company create, business card). Credits only for provider unlocks. Owner: 1 credit for Claude/biz sources, 2 credits for Cognism and other paid providers

Defined in [[brain/audits/03-parity|Audit 3 – mobile vs web]].
